purpose: Authorized MCP AI assistant device acceptance input; this is a checklist, not a deployable configuration bundle.

authorization.targetSelection: Select the authorized device again for every run; historical ports and addresses are not identity evidence.

deviceIdentity.note: Environment names and allocator heap sizes do not prove physical Flash or PSRAM capacity.

preserve: rule scripts and runtime feature choices
configurationPreservation.rollback: Use only a verified backup from the same device after rechecking identity, partitions and active OTA slot; never replay an UNKNOWN write automatically.

local.boundary: Host, mock, H2 and offline browser results are not device evidence.

build.boundary: Firmware, filesystem and artifact validation do not prove deployment or runtime behavior.

deviceApi.requiredEvidence: Current-device preflight, confirmation, apply, readback and matching runId/operationId records.

physical.requiredEvidence: Measured sensor and Modbus values plus independently observed authorized output actions.

longTerm.boundary: Run normal load and fault injection separately; interrupted or shortened windows cannot pass.

standardScenarios.start: Upload an authorized GPIO or sensor document and review its extracted facts.
standardScenarios.physicalEvidence: Compare an actual sensor reading with its source, timestamp and validity.

standardScenarios.start: Review a peripheral execution rule whose action references an existing device target.
standardScenarios.physicalEvidence: Observe the authorized output independently; an accepted command is not physical confirmation.

standardScenarios.start: Review a rule script with declared variables and explicit subscribe and publish topics.
standardScenarios.physicalEvidence: Verify real broker traffic and the resulting device behavior without evaluating scripts in the cloud.

standardScenarios.start: Upload authorized PDF and Excel register documentation and review every extracted field.
requiredSteps: register address data type scale and interval validation
standardScenarios.physicalEvidence: Read actual Modbus values and compare them with the reviewed register definition; injected document text remains untrusted data.

standardScenarios.start: Review reporting topics, secret references and runtime feature choices together.
requiredSteps: topic secret reference and resource validation
standardScenarios.physicalEvidence: Verify the actual broker connection and reporting behavior while preserving existing credentials.

standardScenarios.start: Apply reviewed multi-section changes, then exercise revision conflict, disconnect, UNKNOWN recovery and separately confirmed rollback.
standardScenarios.physicalEvidence: Confirm recovery and rollback on the same authorized device; UNKNOWN or expired writes must not replay automatically.
